Open-Shell Menu 4.4.198
======================

Source:
https://github.com/Open-Shell/Open-Shell-Menu/releases/tag/v4.4.198

The files under portable\PFiles\Open-Shell are extracted unchanged from the
official OpenShellSetup64_4_4_198.msi release package. WGA uses only the Start
Menu component and the bundled Windows XP Luna skin.
